intro: Ullasame Uthsahame is the Christian Telugu Christmas song written, tuned & produced by JC Kuchipudi sung by Joshua Gariki and music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher. This song was released on December 09, 2020 through J K Christopher YouTube Channel.
